Rows aims to bridge the gap between traditional spreadsheet software and modern data needs by providing businesses and individuals with a powerful, flexible platform.

about_short_description.short_description: Rows is the world’s smartest AI spreadsheet. Import cloud data, extract table from PDFs, and build powerful analysis and reports. Easy!

product.name: Rows Spreadsheet Platform
product.description: A cloud-based spreadsheet tool designed for team collaboration, data analysis, and automation without requiring coding skills.

product.name: Rows AI Analyst
product.description: An integrated AI feature that analyzes, summarizes, and transforms spreadsheet data using natural language commands and AI-powered formulas.

product.name: Data Tables and Integrations
product.description: Smart tables that import and automate data from various cloud services and APIs into spreadsheets for analysis and reporting.

product.name: Python Integration
product.description: Built-in Python scripting within spreadsheets for advanced data analysis and statistical modeling without coding.

product.name: Calculators Library
product.description: A collection of pre-built calculators for financial, marketing, and operational metrics accessible within the spreadsheet environment.

product.name: Forms and Interactive Elements
product.description: Tools to convert tables into interactive forms and add input elements like buttons and checkboxes within spreadsheets.
